title: Money Transfer Feature
description: As an authenticated customer, I want to transfer money to another account so that I can move funds without visiting a branch.
acceptance_criteria: Customer can choose a source account and destination account
Transfer completes within 3 seconds for valid requests
Balances update immediately after a successful transfer
Customer sees a clear error when funds are insufficient

comments.author: product_owner
comments.body: Happy path and insufficient-funds behavior are release blockers.

comments.author: qa_lead
comments.body: Prioritize validation around balance updates and duplicate submits.

linked_requirements.title: Authenticated customers can submit valid transfers
Insufficient funds are rejected without balance changes

title: Admin Refund Approval
description: As an operations manager, I want to approve high-value refund requests with audit tracking so that refund risk is controlled.
acceptance_criteria: Approver cannot be the same user who created the request
Approved refunds create an audit entry with actor, timestamp, and amount
Rejected refunds keep the original payment unchanged

comments.author: risk_manager
comments.body: Audit trail evidence must include actor, timestamp, amount, and outcome.

linked_requirements.title: Refund decisions produce immutable audit records
